chain_words.nuance: mild irritation caused by a small thing
repeated annoyance that is becoming harder to ignore
very strong anger that is hard to control
anger so intense it seems out of control

explanation: These words all describe feeling displeased or angry, but they range from mild annoyance to anger that seems out of control.

usage_notes.difference: 'Annoyed' usually describes a reaction to one small event; 'irritated' suggests the feeling has built up over time or keeps returning.
